Manage specific font versions in DOTFONTS and other Dots *FONTS directories
goals.notes:
Requested follow-up: support installing, uninstalling, updating and using specific fonts and versions in the shared Dots fonts directory via SDOTSFONTS, or in another Dots-related *FONTS directory. Add SDOTSFONTS to the shared environment/profile backend and reuse its native shell adapters instead of defining independent shell-only paths. Current inspection found generated DOTSLINUXFONTS, DOTSWSLFONTS, DOTSTERMUXFONTS, DOTSWINDOWSFONTS, profile aliases and PROFILEFONTS, but no SDOTSFONTS.

Keep track of every managed version, including retained versions and the active selection for each destination; updates or switching versions must not silently discard previous versions. Build on the existing versioned library and transaction/recovery engine, preserving existing fonts and unrelated destination contents.

Dependencies: completed fonts command goal 4b1c5e43302e4c808e5b21f997429556 and existing profile/backend work tracked by 765a9e892a1547cd994aad89c7132f87. Existing implementation context: docs/fonts.md, plans/fonts.md and lib/dots/profile_environment.py. This is a new open follow-up, not a claim that directory targeting is already implemented.

User correction: the shared font variable is DOTFONTS, not SDOTSFONTS. This supersedes the spelling in the original request notes. Directory installation stores versioned payloads only; explicit use/set activates them, as agreed. Implementation and isolated directory, popup, backend and command checks are in progress; final verification is running with the corrected name.

Implemented DOTFONTS in the shared profile backend and --directory selection by backend name or path in fonts/dots fonts. Added directories and use, storage-only install/download/import/update/upgrade, exact-version uninstall with persistent history, independent per-directory inventories, provenance/checksums and activation origins. Explicit use/set copies into the personal library, so directory uninstall preserves active fonts and other copies. Pins, ownership checks, stale guards, journaled recovery and scoped undo remain enforced. The popup has an Alt-D directory chooser and keeps scope through reviewed handoffs. Help, completion, canonical docs and local wiki are synchronized.

Verification: 168 passed and 19 existing platform/optional-fixture skips across 12 isolated suites, including 13 directory tests, 21 fonts tests, 5 real private-tmux/FZF browser tests and 14 backend tests. Generated adapters, 241-command metadata validation, Python/Bash syntax, 1105 relative Markdown links and whitespace checks pass. Local wiki build/check passed (transaction ee6b8d6f8abf43258b530fc0c257e0e5). Paired fixture timing runs and Python-free warm startup checks are recorded in plans/fonts.md.

Native PowerShell 5.1/7, native Windows registration/locked-file recovery and visible desktop/device activation remain pending; fixture results do not establish those. No live fonts, app settings or shell session were activated/reloaded, and no commit or push was made. Preserved unrelated working-tree changes, including existing repository font deletions.
acceptance: The shared Dots backend exposes DOTFONTS for the shared fonts directory and resolves existing Dots/profile *FONTS directories consistently across supported native shell adapters and platforms.
Both fonts and dots fonts can install, uninstall, update and use a specifically selected font/version in DOTFONTS or another explicitly selected Dots *FONTS directory.

Persistent inventory tracks every managed font version per destination, including source/release or revision, checksums, retained or installed state and the active selection; restarting the CLI preserves this information.

Updating or switching a font preserves other retained versions and permits selecting an earlier retained version; uninstall affects only the selected font/version and destination while keeping other versions, directories and version history intact.

Destination changes use reviewed, journaled operations with ownership checks, drift refusal and recovery; isolated tests and matching help, completion and documentation cover directory selection and version tracking.

goals.title: Automatic app-font retention, saved preferences and Restore
goals.notes:
Dependencies: 843b750136864c10a973e119aa4f4b9b, 66ce98cf1b284eae86600b89a8a945f2 and completed CLI goal 4b1c5e43302e4c808e5b21f997429556. Store in active-profile fonts directory; Termux retains only selected TTF, desktop apps retain chosen variant styles. Preserve current custom Termux font before first replacement. Save profiles/<active-profile>/fonts.json and add explicit Restore, with missing catalog versions downloaded as needed. Do not adopt missing app configs or apply on startup. All accepted changes are one guarded transaction. No live activation, commit or publication during implementation verification.

Implemented automatic active-profile retention on Set/use --target: one chosen TTF for Termux, selected-variant styles for desktop apps, prior custom Termux preservation, exact profile fonts.json preferences and explicit Restore. Missing cataloged versions stage before one guarded transaction; rollback includes preferences and archives. 17 workflow checks pass, including missing imports, failed downloads, exact remote restore, multi-app changes and preference-write failure rollback. Across focused/affected suites: 124 passed, 1 unavailable-runtime skip. Docs and local wiki synchronized (cf2e85aaf6704ba4ac13a183870c23c2); no live font activation, commit or publication. Native desktop/device acceptance limits remain in plans/fonts.md.
acceptance: Set and use --target retain fonts in the active profile: one TTF for Termux and all styles of the selected family variant for desktop applications; prior selections remain retained.
Missing selected catalog versions are downloaded and validated before a single transaction applies storage, installation, app settings, preferences and inventory.
Active-profile fonts.json records exact app choices and explicit Restore reapplies them without upgrading or mutating during shell startup.
Isolated tests cover current Termux-font preservation, partial-family expansion, stale state, missing local imports, failed downloads, rollback, idempotence and multi-app/batch changes.
Help, metadata, completion, canonical docs, focused plan and generated wiki match behavior, with native acceptance limits recorded.
